bonus.text: Kilsyth-born Bill Irvine and his wife Bobbie won 13 world titles between 1960 and 1968. Their joint MBE in 1967 was the first time ballroom was recognised in the honours list.
Today’s Royal Scottish Country Dance Society first met in Glasgow in 1923, with Ysobel Stewart and Jean Milligan behind its beginnings. Princess Elizabeth became its patron in 1947.
Glasgow’s Barrowland Ballroom, built by Maggie McIver, who had developed the Barras market, opened on Christmas Eve 1934. It burned down in 1958; a replacement opened two years later.
